Berthier: “Geography was our enemy today, Sire. Archduke Charles held the superior ground.”

frames.told:
Berthier: “Stalemate. Massena and Archduke Charles glare at each other across the field.”
Archduke Charles: "Your Emperor needs quick victories. I need only deny them."

Berthier: “The ground itself worked against Lannes. Terrain matters, Sire.”
Archduke John: "The Tyrol holds its passes. So do I."

frames.told:
Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. Reinforcements from Davout, Lannes, Murat and Napoleon bolstered Ney's position — though Bernadotte never arrived, Sire.”
Mack: "A temporary derangement of the arithmetic. Vienna will understand."

Berthier: “The ground itself worked against Lannes. Terrain matters, Sire.”
Archduke John: "The Tyrol holds its passes. So do I."

Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. Reinforcements from Davout, Lannes, Napoleon, Marmont and Senarmont bolstered Ney's position — though Murat and Bernadotte never arrived, Sire.”
Mack: "A temporary derangement of the arithmetic. Vienna will understand."

frames.told:
Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. Reinforcements from Davout, Lannes, Napoleon, Marmont and Senarmont bolstered Ney's position — though Murat and Bernadotte never arrived, Sire.”
Mack: "A temporary derangement of the arithmetic. Vienna will understand."

Berthier: “The ground itself worked against Lannes. Terrain matters, Sire.”
Archduke John: "The Tyrol holds its passes. So do I."
The plan: Napoleon leads; the attack from 2 provinces (+1 on the dice).
The line dresses on the Emperor and goes forward.
The fortune of the day: Napoleon rolls 7, +3 for his eye for ground, +1 for the flank: 11.
Murat, from the reserve, rides them down (First Horseman of Europe): 1,259 more.

Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. A costly day for Mack: the losses ran two to one in Napoleon's favour, and Mack is still in the field. And Mack was taken on that field — France holds him.”
Mack: "I withdraw in perfect conformity with a plan I have just completed."

Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. A costly day for Mack: the losses ran two to one in Napoleon's favour, and Mack is still in the field. And Mack was taken on that field — France holds him.”
Mack: "I withdraw in perfect conformity with a plan I have just completed."

Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. A costly day for Mack: the losses ran two to one in Napoleon's favour, and Mack is still in the field. And Mack was taken on that field — France holds him.”
Mack: "I withdraw in perfect conformity with a plan I have just completed."

Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. A costly day for Mack: the losses ran two to one in Napoleon's favour, and Mack is still in the field. And Mack was taken on that field — France holds him.”
Mack: "I withdraw in perfect conformity with a plan I have just completed."
Soult does not come: awaits explicit orders.
Ney goes in at the head of his men (+15%).
The fortune of the day: Ney rolls 7, +1 for his eye for ground: 8.
Ney advances into Swabia, where Mack still stands.
